title: Transferable Above-Ground Biomass (AGB) Estimation Model from Multi-Sensor Data with Sparse Field Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2608.11638v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spatially continuous quantification of forest above-ground biomass (AGB) is what makes carbon accounting credible and mitigation strategies actionable. While field inventories provide high localized accuracy, they are spatially sparse; conversely, spaceborne LiDAR from the Global Ecosystem Dynamics Investigation (GEDI) offers broad biomass samples but lacks spatial continuity and systematic underestimation of high-biomass forests. This paper presents an operational framework centered on a single globally trained convolutional neural network (CNN) that is seamlessly adapted to each new landscape through a lightweight empirical field-calibration workflow. translated_title: 基于多源数据与稀疏地面校准的可迁移地上生物量估算模型
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.11638v1 公告类型：新 摘要：森林地上生物量（AGB）的空间连续量化是使碳核算可信和减缓策略可操作的关键。虽然实地调查提供了高局部精度，但它们在空间上稀疏；相反，来自全球生态系统动力学调查（GEDI）的星载激光雷达提供了广泛的生物量样本，但缺乏空间连续性，并对高生物量森林存在系统性低估。本文提出了一种操作框架，其核心是单一全球训练的卷积神经网络（CNN），通过轻量级经验实地校准工作流，无缝适应每个新景观。该全球模型结合了光学（Sentinel-2）、C波段SAR（Sentinel-1）、L波段SAR（ALOS-2 PALSAR-2）和地形（DEM）数据。它针对覆盖多个区域及干湿季节的GEDI Level-4A生物量参考数据进行一次性训练，从而学习持久的木本结构特征。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于单一全球训练CNN模型，结合多源遥感数据（光学、SAR、地形）和轻量级实地校准，实现跨区域可迁移且高精度的森林地上生物量估算方法，解决了GEDI数据空间不连续和高生物量低估问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a globally trained single CNN model integrating multi-source remote sensing data (optical, SAR, terrain) with lightweight field calibration, enabling transferable and accurate above-ground biomass estimation across regions while addressing GEDI's spatial discontinuity and high-biomass underestimation issues.
